title: Archaeopteryx.js
description: A full tree-viewer application (control panel, node menu, overview, built-in heat map, alignment, logo and domain tracks) launched imperatively into a container; it has no node-click callback, so clicks, highlight and focus are adapter workarounds.

applied: customisation: hide features (official config): collapseControlPanel (panel folded to its header bar), enableDownloads/enableSubtreeDeletion/enableAccessToDatabases false, panelDensity compact, rootOffset reduced; the demo option 'Show Archaeopteryx control panel' switches back to the full panel

tree background (rect.basebackground fill) from --bg1 and default branch colour from --fg2 (dark: --fg3): CSS attribute-selector overrides with !important on the generated SVG (partial: not an official option, breaks if the SVG structure changes)

tip label colour from --fg1, search-hit label, halo and dot colour from --color-primary (selectors match the library's fixed default colour values), tip label font-family from --font-body and italic: CSS !important on text.extlabel (partial)

control panel and node menu re-themed through the --p-* CSS custom properties the library's panel is built on: accent and ink from --color-primary, --fg1, --fg3, --border-default, --bg1/--bg2, font from --font-body (partial: undocumented variables)

clade colours from the GBIF categorical palette (--purple-100, --periwinkle-100, --fuchsia-100, --peach-100, --lightblue-100): written to node.color (the phyloXML branch colour field) on the live tree object, then a redraw (partial)
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) map to the same CSS custom properties on the container
dark theme: the library's own light/dark switch (the adapter clicks its theme button); the tree and panel then use the library's dark palette, not GBIF colours (GBIF defines no dark set)

backdrop-filter blur on the panel, node menu and tooltips switched off by CSS (frames of 150 to 250 ms were seen in software compositing while a node menu was open; the blur was removed as a precaution and was not proven to be the whole cause)
not_possible: colours, fonts and sizes by configuration: the launch config has no such keys (118 keys were removed in 3.0 and passing one throws), so every token style above is selector-level CSS on generated DOM, which the project itself changes between releases (3.6.0 restructured the SVG, 3.24.0 removed a CSS class)

label font size, node size and branch width from code per node: only global values (view.font, view.node, view.branch) or style:font_size / style:node_shape / style:node_color properties read at launch; dot sizes are otherwise fixed

per-node style from a callback: only phyloXML style:* properties read once at launch (verified honoured: node_color, node_shape, font_color, font_size, font_style; verified not honoured: node_size, font name, node_transparency); changing them needs a relaunch
the library's search/highlight colour, halo size and dimming of non-hits (everything not matched fades, including coloured clades); the colour is only overridden by value-matching CSS
heat-map colour scale (viridis ramp), alignment residue colours, legend and tooltip chrome (tooltips and the legend card are library HTML/SVG with their own look)
dark mode in GBIF colours: the library's dark palette is fixed

hiding the overview miniature, the floating panel header, the alignment navigation bar (position:fixed to the viewport, outside the container) or the legend card: no config key; CSS hiding would be a hack and was not applied
label collision layout: the library measures label widths with its own font, so overriding font-family by CSS changes glyph widths but not its measurements (effect not measured)
styling.notes: Styling a full application: the chrome that can be restyled (panel, menu) works through its CSS variables; the tree itself is styled by overriding generated attributes. Everything is documented in docs/results/archaeopteryx-js.md.
